channel.title: Vintage Story Mod DB - Latest Updates
channel.description: Newest mod releases and updates from the Vintage Story Mod DB

item.title: Temporal Microwave
item.description: A Temporal Microwave! Cooks, warms and rewinds food to a fresher state.

item.title: Advanced Tool Parts
item.description: Add handles and bindings to your tools to make them faster and last longer!

item.title: DST - NPC additions
item.description: Additional NPC mobs using the vanilla villager model.

item.title: Wilderlands Rustbound
item.description: Overhauls drifter canon, adds a slew of new Rust-related entities and challenges.

item.title: Walkable Deck
item.description: Stand up and walk a boat deck while it sails. Vanilla boats; no other mod required.

item.title: Starter Kit Bundle
item.description: New players get a deployable bundle that unpacks into a stocked starter container.

item.title: Buddy Beacon
item.description: Useful tools to play with buddies - Teleport/Summon to Target Player with Consent & Beacon system.

item.title: Veganized
item.description: Plants make the real vanilla fat, wax and bone meal, so every recipe that wants them just works.

item.title: Wilderlands Adjustments
item.description: A repository for a number of configurable values to adjust base game and Wilderlands mods content.

item.title: BetterChinese
item.description: 更好的汉化

item.title: RAM Garbage Collector
item.description: Generic RAM memory optimization and distance culling suite

item.title: Star Trek Turbolift and Teleport pad
item.description: Adds turbolifts and teleportation pads to the game for specific megabuilds.

item.title: AnMiTech Continued
item.description: restoring a forgotten mod that includes weapons and armors from various cultures

item.title: Newfies Server Essentials Suite
item.description: Newfies Server Essentials Suite 🛡️ Protect 🧾 Investigate ⚡ Diagnose 🛠️ Manage

item.title: Pinku
item.description: destroys the purple that dares to masquarade as pink; as well as other pink related things

item.title: qol crafts continued
item.description: A continuation of qolcrafts

item.title: Candela
item.description: Candles that burn down, tallow candles you dip by hand, and clay moulds you pour. Light means work.

item.title: Outstanding Ebony
item.description: Adds ebony fruit, also known as jackalberry, as a drop to ebony trees. Expanded Foods compatible!

item.title: VS Roofing Mod
item.description: Gridless roof building system with vanilla style roofs, glass houses and more!

item.title: Prosequor - Skills, Levels, Trees and Stats
item.description: Adds a full-throated, first-class skill, levelling and attributes system to Vintage Story.

item.title: Smart TV
item.description: This mod adds a flat screen wall mounted tv that is resizable. Only available in the creative menu

item.title: Wind Chimes
item.description: Add decorative wind chimes

item.title: Floating Text Images and Gifs
item.description: Adds Floating text to your game.

item.title: Esoterica
item.description: A sixth history community license mod merging the lore from Cultist Simulator with Vintage Story.

item.title: Diet Setup
item.description: Configurable food preferences, nutrition and spoilage responses, with optional race diets.

item.title: RFMechanics
item.description: Race-specific abilities and survival mechanics. WIP but currently has climbing, growing orcs, etc

item.title: Race Framework
item.description: Racial strengths, drawbacks and class choices for various races

item.title: Fancy Fences
item.description: Adds new fences and fence gates.

item.title: NDL ExpandedGrowth (Coral Growth Module)
item.description: Adds a method for growing/harvest coral chunks.

item.title: Lost and Found
item.description: Players can find items that were lost/discarded by others via panning, terraforming or fishing!
